# GSVision Viewer

Experience 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes in stunning virtual reality on your Meta Quest 3.

## What is Gaussian Splatting?

Gaussian Splatting is a cutting-edge 3D reconstruction technique that creates photorealistic 3D scenes from photos. Unlike traditional 3D models, Gaussian Splats capture real-world environments with incredible detail and lighting accuracy.
